title: unify-sdks-auth-retries-streaming-ergonomics-v1.151.0
author: Maya Chen
description: This PR consolidates the auth/retries/streaming ergonomics work across the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs and bumps SDK packages to v1.151.0. Motivation: previously SDKs had diverging retry semantics and streaming ergonomics that made cross-team integration harder and produced subtle production bugs (token duplication on reconnect, inconsistent retry backoff on 429/503). This change aims to: 1) unify authentication token refresh semantics (single source-of-truth helper, deterministic background refresh with jitter), 2) standardize retry/backoff policy and transient error classification across languages, 3) improve streaming APIs ergonomics (resumable streams, explicit Cancel/Close semantics, clearer async iteration patterns), 4) apply parity fixes so feature surface is consistent between SDKs, and 5) bump versions to v1.151.0 for all three SDKs. Changes include a common design doc (src/sdks/README/sdk-unification.md) and language-specific ergonomic wrappers that adhere to the shared spec. Checklist: - [x] design review completed (ENG-2145) - [x] implement shared auth helper and language bindings - [x] unify retry policy and update docs - [x] add streaming resume tokens and tests - [x] run integration tests against hosted API - [x] update CHANGELOGs and perform version bumps - [x] QA smoke tests on Dedicated staging Notes for reviewers: the implementation keeps in-language idiomatic APIs (async iterators for TS/Python, io.Reader-style for Go) while sharing the underlying retry/auth behavior. There are small API surface additions (Stream.resume(token) and ClientOptions.retry_policy) that are non-breaking and optional. Migration notes: users can adopt the new retry_policy and streaming resume without changes; default behavior remains backward compatible. This PR also fixes a production issue where streaming reconnects could re-deliver buffered tokens when authentication refreshed concurrently (incidence: INT-1120).

release_notes: SDKs: v1.151.0 — unify auth token refresh and retry semantics across Python/TypeScript/Go; add streaming resume API and ergonomics improvements; fix token duplication on streaming reconnect (INT-1120); non-breaking additions: ClientOptions.retry_policy, Stream.resume(token).
testing_summary: Ran full unit and integration matrix across Python/TS/Go on CI. Performed Dedicated staging smoke tests (latency/load) and validated streaming resume under dropped-connection scenarios. Added regression tests for token duplication and retry behavior.
upgrade_instructions: Non-breaking. To opt into new retry config, pass ClientOptions.retry_policy. To use streaming resume, call Stream.resume(token) or use the provided ergonomic wrappers. See sdks/*/CHANGELOG.md for examples.
notes: This PR intentionally avoids changing default behavior; it centralizes logic to make future security and perf fixes easier to roll out across languages. Follow-up work: deprecate old per-sdk retry shims (ENG-2199) and migrate internal samples.
risk_assessment: Low-medium: behavior is backward compatible by default. Risk areas are streaming reconnect paths and cross-language parity differences; covered by added tests and manual staging smoke tests.
